verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms Retell serves an llms.txt at docs.retellai.com that describes its voice-agent docs for LLM consumption. Its documentation pages are also published as raw markdown (.md) URLs, which agents can ingest directly. Missing for 10: first-party documentation explaining the llms.txt/agent-docs offering (e.g. an llms-full.txt variant), independent or hands-on corroboration of agents using it.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
